title: GoAdserver Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the GoAdserver adapter

token.description: Publisher token from the GoAdserver panel. The GoAdserver gateway routes the request to the publisher's deployment by this token

floor.description: Bid floor in USD CPM, applied when the impression has no bidfloor of its own

subid.description: Sub-identifier for stats attribution (page section, A/B group, etc.)
